name: scene_batch_4
title: Card scenes, batch 4
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its centre. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b4/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.note: Written for Black Ice Citadel. Shown on Black Ice Citadel and Node Severance. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
